measurement_limits: The pilot is diagnostic and excluded from the formal comparison.
Decisions use independent local clocks and the existing marker/glyph thresholds.
RGB crop compares the two 1:1 early static XTerm captures. It is a text raster diagnostic.
Each stage p95 maximum is the maximum of observed recent-window p95s, without merging quantiles.
Scroll-copy totals are computed only from fully reported selected authenticated host windows.
Formal ranges use complete comparable pairs. Failed attempts remain in the ledger.
Worst is lower for FPS and foreground coverage and higher for gaps and errors. More copied frames alone is not a quality ranking.
Raw endpoint credentials, boot IDs, addresses and remote runtime paths were omitted.
The cadence gate and static raster checks do not encode a threshold for the longest visible gap.

gap_investigation.scope: Endpoint-local replay of an internal B-arm freeze and the corresponding completed A arm.
